advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Confirm the breaking search-output change (esp. MCP having no --full) is communicated to downstream consumers and covered by a changelog/migration note.
evidence: src/rebar/_engine_support/reads.py:526: `return [project_search_result(t, query) for t in public_results]`
src/rebar/_mcp_reads.py: `SearchResultOut.model_validate(t)` replaces `TicketStateOut.model_validate(t)` with no full opt-in on MCP
ticket 296a description: 'Changing the default search shape is an intentional breaking change'; migration is `search --full` (CLI/library) or `show` (MCP)
advisory.finding: Default search output shape changes across CLI, library, and MCP from full ticket state to an 8-field bounded projection, and MCP search loses any path to full ticket bodies (no --full on MCP). This is an intentional but breaking public-contract change that downstream consumers relying on description/comments in search results will hit.
scenarios: An MCP client or library caller that previously read `description`/`comments` from search results
CLI JSON consumers parsing the prior full-state array

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Assert the search JSON result list and the parsed LLM NDJSON rows are non-empty before the validation loops in test_search_result_json_and_llm.
evidence: `for t in rebar.search("Task", repo_root=s["repo"]): v.validate(t)` — no assertion that the list is non-empty
`for line in llm.stdout.splitlines(): if line.strip(): llm_validator.validate(json.loads(line))` — an empty/whitespace-only stdout skips all validation silently

The sibling MCP test (tests/interfaces/facades/test_mcp_output_schema_coverage.py:314) explicitly guards this with `assert result, f"{name} returned an empty list; cannot confirm item shape"`, showing the intended pattern is absent here
advisory.finding: test_search_result_json_and_llm validates search JSON/LLM output inside loops with no non-empty guard, so a regression that makes search return zero results would leave every validator uncalled and the test would pass green (schema conformance goes unverified).
scenarios: A projection regression returns [] for the seeded 'Task' query; schema conformance for search_result / search_result_llm is never actually exercised but CI stays green
advisory.suggested_fix: Bind the results to a variable and assert non-empty, e.g. `rows = rebar.search("Task", repo_root=s["repo"]); assert rows` and `parsed = [json.loads(l) for l in llm.stdout.splitlines() if l.strip()]; assert parsed`, then validate each.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add the short-key→long-key map to search_result_llm.schema.json (top-level description and/or per-property `description`s: ttl→title, t→ticket_type, st→status, pr→priority, a→alias, sm→summary, sn→snippet), matching the ticket_state_llm.schema.json convention.
evidence: search_result_llm.schema.json:5 description only says 'Token-minified bounded search result emitted as NDJSON by search --output llm. Nullable values are omitted.' — no key map

Sibling convention: ticket_state_llm.schema.json:5 embeds a full 'Key map: ticket_id→id, ticket_type→t, title→ttl, ...' AND per-property descriptions (e.g. lines 16-27 'a'->'alias', 'desc'->'description')
search_result_llm.schema.json:9-18 declares short keys id/a/ttl/t/st/pr/sm/sn with NO per-property description mapping them to their long names

Corpus AC pinning the convention: docs/experiments/plan-review-gate/runs/operator_attested_ac_corpus.jsonl:271 '`csn` is enumerated in `ticket_state_llm.schema.json` (properties + description key-map)'
advisory.finding: New search_result_llm.schema.json omits the short-key→long-key map that its sibling ticket_state_llm.schema.json establishes as the decoding convention for token-minified LLM output; the LLM consumer of `search --output llm` NDJSON has no schema-provided way to map ttl/sm/sn/a/t/st/pr back to title/summary/snippet/alias/ticket_type/status/priority.
scenarios: An LLM or agent consuming `search --output llm` NDJSON reads the schema to decode the minified keys and finds no ttl/sm/sn mapping
advisory.suggested_fix: Extend the description to include a 'Key map: ticket_id→id, title→ttl, ticket_type→t, status→st, priority→pr, alias→a, summary→sm, snippet→sn.' clause and/or add per-property `description` fields, mirroring ticket_state_llm.schema.json.
